generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policy-level location rows in the current exposure extract for the modelled lines of business.
generic.In-scope period: Current monthly exposure as-of date, scored against the prior month for movement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Geocode, construction, occupancy, year built, TIV and secondary modifiers present on every scored row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored row count equals the in-force location count in the warehouse extract with zero unscored rows.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring job output stored in the warehouse with run timestamp and DQ rule-set version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows below the minimum acceptable band queued with a reason code and a named remediation owner.
generic.Test population: Every in-force location row in the scored extract plus ten randomly sampled policies.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero null scores and weighted portfolio DQ score at or above the agreed target threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Sub-threshold rows route to the exposure exception queue for Data Analyst triage and rework.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Score card covers all six dimensions and sampled policies match the policy admin attribute state.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse DQ schema tables plus the Excel score card filed in the exposure reporting folder.

steps.title: Load the in-force exposure extract into the data warehouse scoring schema
sop: Load the current as-of exposure extract into the warehouse scoring schema.
Confirm the load completed and capture the row count and TIV control total.
Done when the extract is staged with its row count and TIV recorded.
verify: Compare staged row count to the source extract control total.
Pass when the staged count and TIV equal the source extract values.

steps.title: Confirm the DQ rule set and scoring weights in the warehouse configuration
sop: Open the DQ rule set configuration and confirm the six scoring dimensions are active.
Confirm dimension weights match the approved scoring standard for this cycle.
Done when the active rule-set version is confirmed and recorded on the run.
verify: Check the rule-set version stamp against the approved standard.
Pass when the active version and weights match the approved standard.

steps.title: Run the exposure DQ scoring job in the data warehouse
sop: Execute the scoring job across all staged in-force location rows.
Check the job log for failed partitions or skipped rows and rerun as needed.
Done when the job completes and every in-force location row carries a score.
verify: Query the scored table for null or unpopulated score values.
Pass when zero in-force location rows return a null score.

steps.title: Compute the weighted portfolio DQ score and prior-month delta in Excel
sop: Export dimension-level scores and build the TIV-weighted portfolio score in Excel.
Add the prior-month score and calculate the delta by dimension.
Done when the weighted score, target threshold, and delta are on the score card.
verify: Recompute the weighted score from the dimension detail.
Pass when the recomputed score equals the score card figure.

steps.title: Spot-check ten sampled policies against the policy administration record
sop: Select ten policies at random from the scored population.
Compare scored attribute state to the policy admin record field by field.
Record any mismatch with the policy number and the attribute affected.
Done when all ten samples are checked and mismatches are recorded.
verify: Review the sample sheet for unexplained mismatches.
Pass when every sampled score reflects the actual policy attribute state.

steps.title: Route sub-threshold records to the exposure exception queue in the warehouse
sop: Select rows scoring below the minimum acceptable band.
Write them to the exception queue with a reason code and remediation owner.
Done when every sub-threshold row sits in the queue with a reason code.
verify: Compare the queued row count to the sub-threshold row count.
Pass when the two counts agree and no row lacks a reason code.

steps.title: Archive the score card and scoring evidence in the warehouse DQ schema
sop: Save the score card and dimension detail under the as-of date folder.
Stamp the artefacts with run timestamp and DQ rule-set version.
Done when the evidence set is archived with timestamp and version.
verify: Open the archived artefacts and read the stamped metadata.
Pass when timestamp and rule-set version are present and correct.

generic.Defined scope/population: The validated exposure extract released for the current as-of date plus its DQ metadata file.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date, archived under the versioned as-of-date folder.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Archive manifest carries portfolio, as-of date, version, row count, TIV and exception count.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Manifest row count and TIV control total equal the delivered extract file exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive entry carries an immutable timestamp and the retention clock is started.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Archive or manifest mismatches raised as issues and cleared before the entry is marked final.
generic.Test population: The archived extract, its DQ metadata file, and the archive manifest entry.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Row count and TIV must match the delivered file with zero tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed archive write or control-total mismatch is re-run before the lineage record is registered.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Naming convention portfolio_asof_version applied and lineage record points at the archive path.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse archive path for the extract with the manifest in the document management repository.

steps.title: Confirm the exposure extract is validated and released for archive
sop: Confirm validation is complete and no blocking exception remains open.
Confirm the extract version to be archived is the released version.
Done when the released extract version is identified for archive.
verify: Check the validation status flag on the extract.
Pass when the extract is marked validated and released.

steps.title: Write the extract to the warehouse archive path using the naming convention
sop: Write the file to the archive path as portfolio_asof_version.
Confirm the write completed and the file size is non-zero.
Done when the file is present at the archive path under the correct name.
verify: List the archive folder and read the file name.
Pass when the name follows portfolio_asof_version and the file opens.

steps.title: Attach the DQ metadata file alongside the extract in the archive folder
sop: Assemble score, record count, exception count and rule-set version into the metadata file.
Store it in the same archive folder as the extract.
Done when the metadata file sits beside the extract with all four values.
verify: Open the metadata file and read each value.
Pass when score, counts and rule-set version are all populated.

steps.title: Record row count and TIV control totals in the archive manifest
sop: Compute row count and TIV from the archived file.
Enter both into the archive manifest entry for this as-of date.
Done when the manifest carries both control totals.
verify: Recompute the totals from the archived file and compare to the manifest.
Pass when manifest totals equal the delivered file totals.

steps.title: Confirm the archive timestamp and retention clock in the document repository
sop: Open the archive entry and read the recorded timestamp.
Confirm the retention policy is applied and the clock has started.
Done when timestamp and retention status are both confirmed.
verify: Check the retention field on the archive entry.
Pass when an immutable timestamp and an active retention period are shown.

steps.title: Register the archive location in the warehouse lineage record
sop: Add the archive path and version to the lineage record for this exposure set.
Link the lineage entry to the downstream model run consumers.
Done when downstream runs can resolve the archive path from lineage.
verify: Follow the lineage link back to the archived file.
Pass when the lineage entry resolves to the correct archived extract.

generic.Defined scope/population: All geocoded exposure locations in the current extract requiring hazard layer assignment.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date using the hazard dataset vintage approved for this cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Wind, flood zone, seismic and wildfire hazard codes populated on every geocoded location.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Hazard-assigned location count equals the geocoded location count in the exposure set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hazard vendor name and dataset version stamped on the exposure job for reproducibility.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Locations with conflicting vendor hazard codes logged with the selected value and reason.
generic.Test population: Every geocoded location row, with coastal locations tested separately.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero locations left unassigned or defaulted to a country-level hazard code.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched locations return to geocoding for resolution before hazard assignment is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hazard lookup resolution matches the geocode resolution the location supports.
generic.Evidence location: Hazard assignment output in the cat modeling platform with the vendor version stamp on the job.

steps.title: Confirm the approved hazard dataset version with the Catastrophe Data Provider
sop: Check the provider release notes for the current hazard dataset version.
Confirm the version is the one approved for this modelling cycle.
Done when the approved hazard dataset version is confirmed and noted.
verify: Compare the loaded dataset version to the approved version.
Pass when the loaded version equals the approved version.

steps.title: Load the vendor hazard layers into the cat modeling platform
sop: Load wind, flood zone, seismic and wildfire layers into the platform.
Confirm each layer loads without error and covers the written territory.
Done when all four layers are loaded and cover the territory.
verify: List loaded layers and their coverage extents.
Pass when all four layers are present and cover the written territory.

steps.title: Run hazard attachment against the geocoded exposure set in the platform
sop: Execute hazard attachment across all geocoded locations.
Review the job log for unmatched or errored locations.
Done when the attachment job completes across the full exposure set.
verify: Query locations with a null hazard code.
Pass when no geocoded location is left without a hazard code.

steps.title: Check hazard lookup resolution against each location geocode level
sop: Compare each location hazard resolution to its geocode match level.
List locations that fell back to a coarser hazard than the geocode supports.
Done when no location defaults to a country-level hazard.
verify: Count locations carrying a country-default hazard code.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: Verify flood zone and distance-to-coast values for coastal locations
sop: Filter the exposure set to coastal locations.
Confirm flood zone and distance-to-coast are populated for each.
Done when every coastal location carries both values.
verify: Query coastal locations for null flood zone or distance-to-coast.
Pass when no coastal location is missing either value.

steps.title: Log the hazard vendor and version stamp on the exposure job
sop: Record the hazard vendor, product and version on the exposure job record.
Confirm the stamp is stored with the run so the assignment can be reproduced.
Done when the vendor and version stamp is saved against the job.
verify: Reopen the job record and read the vendor and version fields.
Pass when both fields are populated on the saved job.

steps.title: Review conflicting multi-vendor hazard codes and record the selection
sop: List locations where vendor hazard codes disagree materially.
Select the value to use and record the reason for the selection.
Done when every conflicted location carries a selected value and reason.
verify: Review the conflict log for entries lacking a reason.
Pass when every conflict carries a selected value and a recorded reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: All exposure locations requiring vendor construction and occupancy classification for this run.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date using the mapping table version tied to the vendor model version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every location carries a vendor construction class and a vendor occupancy class code.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coded location count equals the exposure set location count with no unmapped remainder.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping table version and vendor model version recorded against the coding run.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policy classes with no vendor equivalent escalated to Underwriting with a tracked correction.
generic.Test population: All coded locations, with default-coded locations reported as a separate slice.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Default-coded location percentage at or below the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unknown-class locations require an exception reason or a source-system correction request.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping table version matches the vendor model version used for the modelling run.
generic.Evidence location: Coded exposure set in the cat modeling platform with the mapping workbook in the exposure folder.

steps.title: Confirm the approved mapping table version against the vendor model version
sop: Open the approved construction and occupancy mapping table.
Confirm its version matches the vendor model version used for this run.
Done when the mapping table version is confirmed as matched.
verify: Compare the mapping table version stamp to the vendor model version.
Pass when the two versions correspond per the approved mapping standard.

steps.title: Extract policy construction and occupancy codes from the policy administration system
sop: Pull source construction and occupancy codes for all in-scope policies.
Confirm the extract covers every location in the exposure set.
Done when source codes are available for all exposure locations.
verify: Compare extracted code count to the exposure location count.
Pass when every location has a source code or a recorded blank.

steps.title: Apply the mapping table to derive vendor classes in the cat modeling platform
sop: Run the mapping to translate source codes into vendor construction and occupancy classes.
Review the mapping log for unmapped source values.
Done when every location carries a vendor construction and occupancy class.
verify: Query locations missing either vendor class.
Pass when no location lacks a vendor construction or occupancy class.

steps.title: List locations left on the vendor unknown class in the platform
sop: Filter locations coded to the vendor unknown construction or occupancy class.
Record an exception reason for each remaining unknown.
Done when every unknown-class location carries an exception reason.
verify: Review the unknown-class list for entries without a reason.
Pass when no unknown-class location is left without a reason.

steps.title: Measure and report the default-coded rate against tolerance
sop: Split coded locations into source-derived and default-coded.
Compute the default-coded count and percentage of the population.
Compare the percentage to the agreed tolerance.
Done when the default rate is measured and compared to tolerance.
verify: Recompute the default rate from the coded output.
Pass when the reported rate matches and is within tolerance or is escalated.

steps.title: Escalate unmappable policy classes to Underwriting for source correction
sop: List policy classes with no vendor equivalent and the TIV affected.
Raise a source-system correction request to Underwriting for each.
Done when each unmappable class has a raised correction request.
verify: Check the request log for an open item per unmappable class.
Pass when every unmappable class has a logged request with an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current-period exposure validation results at portfolio and line-of-business level.
generic.In-scope period: Current period compared against the immediately preceding validation period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current and prior weighted DQ scores, geocode resolution mix and open exception counts present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Prior-period figures used equal the figures published in the prior-period DQ report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Comparison workbook saved with period labels and the DQ rule-set version for both periods.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every deteriorating dimension logged with a root cause and an owning team.
generic.Test population: All scored dimensions plus every open exposure data exception.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Weighted DQ score improved and open exception count fell versus the prior period.
generic.Exception handling path: Missed improvement targets trigger a revised remediation plan agreed with Underwriting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Improvement measured on the same rule set for both periods or the change is disclosed.
generic.Evidence location: Comparison workbook in Excel with the underlying period scores held in the data warehouse.

steps.title: Pull current and prior period DQ scores from the data warehouse
sop: Query the scored tables for the current and prior as-of dates.
Confirm both periods used a comparable rule set and note any change.
Done when both period score sets are extracted and comparable.
verify: Compare the prior-period figures to the published prior report.
Pass when the extracted prior figures match what was published.

steps.title: Compare weighted DQ scores by portfolio and line of business in Excel
sop: Build the comparison at portfolio and line-of-business level.
Compute the movement per level and highlight declines.
Done when movement is computed for every portfolio and line.
verify: Recompute a sample of movements from the source scores.
Pass when the recomputed movements match the workbook.

steps.title: Compare the geocode resolution mix across the two periods
sop: Compare the share of street and parcel-level matches period over period.
Note the direction of movement in the resolution mix.
Done when the resolution mix movement is quantified.
verify: Check the mix percentages sum correctly for each period.
Pass when the mix reconciles and the movement is stated.

steps.title: Compare open exposure exception counts and ageing in the warehouse
sop: Count open exposure data exceptions in each period.
List exceptions that have aged past their due date.
Done when the count movement and the aged list are produced.
verify: Compare the aged list against the exception due dates.
Pass when every aged item appears on the list.

steps.title: Document deteriorating dimensions with root cause and owning team
sop: For each dimension that declined, establish the root cause.
Assign an owning team to each declining dimension.
Done when every decline carries a root cause and an owner.
verify: Review the decline list for entries without a cause or owner.
Pass when no decline is left unexplained or unowned.

steps.title: Record sign-off on improvement targets agreed with Underwriting
sop: Compare actual movement to the improvement targets agreed with Underwriting.
Record sign-off where targets were met or raise a revised plan.
Done when sign-off or a revised plan is recorded.
verify: Check the record for a dated sign-off or a raised plan.
Pass when one of the two is present and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: All extracted exposure rows being transformed into the cat platform import layout.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date with the FX rate date recorded for the conversion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Location, coverage, financial terms and secondary modifier fields populated per the import schema.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consolidated row count and TIV reconcile to the source extract with every drop explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consolidated file saved with layout version, FX rate date and transformation run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows dropped or failing the layout validator logged with the reason and their disposition.
generic.Test population: The full consolidated file plus a sample of policies checked for financial term carry-through.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero schema or mandatory-field errors and zero unexplained row or TIV differences.
generic.Exception handling path: Schema errors return to transformation for correction before hand-off is attempted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Currency and TIV expressed in the single reporting currency with the FX rate date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Consolidated file in the data warehouse with the reconciliation workbook held in Excel.

steps.title: Map the source extract fields to the cat platform import layout
sop: Map source columns to location, coverage, financial terms and secondary modifier fields.
Confirm the layout version matches the cat platform release in use.
Done when every import layout field has a mapped source or a documented default.
verify: Review the mapping sheet for unmapped mandatory fields.
Pass when no mandatory import field is unmapped.

steps.title: Run the transformation job in the data warehouse
sop: Execute the transformation into the import layout.
Review the job log for rejected or dropped rows.
Done when the transformation completes and the output file is written.
verify: Check the job status and the output row count.
Pass when the job completed without an unhandled error.

steps.title: Reconcile consolidated row count and TIV to the source extract in Excel
sop: Compare consolidated row count and TIV to the source extract totals.
Itemise every drop with its reason line by line.
Done when the difference is fully explained by the itemised drops.
verify: Add the itemised drops back to the consolidated total.
Pass when the rebuilt total equals the source extract total.

steps.title: Convert currency and TIV to the reporting currency with the FX rate date
sop: Apply the approved FX rates for the as-of date to non-reporting-currency rows.
Record the FX rate table and rate date on the transformation run.
Done when all TIV values sit in the single reporting currency.
verify: Query the file for rows in a currency other than the reporting currency.
Pass when no such rows remain and the rate date is recorded.

steps.title: Verify policy financial terms carried through unchanged from source
sop: Sample policies and compare deductible, limit, attachment and share to source.
Record any field that changed through the transformation.
Done when the sample comparison is complete with differences recorded.
verify: Review the sample comparison for unexplained differences.
Pass when sampled financial terms match source values exactly.

steps.title: Run the import layout validator before hand-off
sop: Run the layout validator over the consolidated file.
Correct any schema or mandatory-field errors and rerun.
Done when the validator returns zero errors.
verify: Read the validator output summary.
Pass when zero schema or mandatory-field errors are reported.

steps.title: Hand the consolidated file to Exposure Management for release
sop: Review the reconciliation and validator output before accepting the file.
Record acceptance and release the file for delivery.
Done when the file is accepted and released.
verify: Check the hand-off record for the acceptance entry.
Pass when a dated acceptance is recorded against the file version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Persistent exposure data gaps by underwriting team and by attribute across the portfolio.
generic.In-scope period: Gaps open at the current as-of date and persisting across at least the prior two periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each gap carries attribute, underwriting team, TIV affected, root cause and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gap TIV totals in the plan reconcile to the DQ report gap population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed remediation plan filed in the document repository with version and agreement date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps Underwriting declines to fix at source recorded with the accepted pipeline workaround.
generic.Test population: Every persistent gap included in the plan and every assigned underwriting owner.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each gap has a named Underwriting owner and a target date, with a closing DQ threshold stated.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps without an accepted owner escalate to the Underwriting lead for assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan states which gaps are fixed at source versus corrected in the exposure pipeline.
generic.Evidence location: Signed plan in the document management repository with items open in the issue tracker.

steps.title: Compile persistent gaps by underwriting team from the DQ reporting output
sop: List gaps that remained open across the last two reporting periods.
Group them by underwriting team and by attribute.
Rank each group by TIV affected.
Done when the ranked gap list is complete.
verify: Compare the gap TIV total to the DQ report gap population.
Pass when the totals reconcile.

steps.title: Agree source-system versus pipeline fixes with Underwriting
sop: Walk the gap list with Underwriting in the working session.
Agree per gap whether the fix is at source or in the exposure pipeline.
Done when every gap carries an agreed fix route.
verify: Review the gap list for entries without a fix route.
Pass when no gap is left without an agreed route.

steps.title: Record the root cause per gap in the issue log
sop: Classify each gap cause as submission quality, broker data, system field or process.
Record the classification in the issue log entry.
Done when every gap carries a recorded root cause.
verify: Query the issue log for gaps without a cause classification.
Pass when every gap entry carries a cause.

steps.title: Set remediation target dates and closing DQ thresholds per team
sop: Agree a target date per team with Underwriting.
State the DQ score threshold that closes each item.
Done when every item has a target date and a closing threshold.
verify: Review items for missing dates or thresholds.
Pass when both are present on every item.

steps.title: Assign Underwriting owners in the issue tracking system
sop: Create or update the tracker item for each gap.
Assign a named Underwriting owner rather than an Exposure Management owner.
Done when every item is assigned to a named Underwriting owner.
verify: List tracker items by owning function.
Pass when no gap item is owned solely by Exposure Management.

steps.title: File the signed remediation plan in the document management repository
sop: Assemble the plan listing gap, cause, owner and due date.
Obtain Underwriting agreement and file the signed version.
Done when the signed plan is filed with its agreement date.
verify: Open the filed plan and check for signature and date.
Pass when the filed plan is signed and dated.

steps.title: Publish the plan to the underwriting workstation for the owning teams
sop: Surface each team gap list and target date in the underwriting workstation.
Confirm each owning team can see its own items.
Done when every team sees its assigned items in the workstation.
verify: Check the workstation view for one team per gap group.
Pass when each team view shows its assigned items.

generic.Defined scope/population: The released validated exposure file for the current as-of date delivered to the cat platform.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date with the extract version tagged on the loaded set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Location, coverage, financial terms and geocode fields present and accepted by the platform loader.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Platform location count and TIV equal the delivered file control totals exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hand-off log entry carries timestamp, file hash, extract version and DQ score.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected records logged with the rejection reason and cleared before delivery is accepted.
generic.Test population: All delivered location records loaded into the cat platform exposure set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero rejected or skipped location records on load.
generic.Exception handling path: A load with rejects is corrected at source and redelivered rather than partially accepted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CAT Modeler acknowledgement recorded and the prior exposure set retired from selection.
generic.Evidence location: Cat modeling platform exposure set plus the hand-off log held with the warehouse archive.

steps.title: Confirm control totals on the released file in the data warehouse
sop: Read the row count and TIV control totals from the archive manifest.
Confirm the file to be delivered is the released version.
Done when control totals and file version are confirmed.
verify: Recompute totals from the file and compare to the manifest.
Pass when the recomputed totals equal the manifest totals.

steps.title: Deliver the file to the cat modeling platform account
sop: Transfer the file to the platform account for the current cycle.
Trigger the platform load and monitor to completion.
Done when the load completes and a result summary is returned.
verify: Read the load result summary for rejects.
Pass when the platform reports zero rejected records.

steps.title: Compare loaded location count and TIV to the delivered control totals
sop: Query loaded location count and TIV in the platform.
Compare both to the delivered file control totals.
Done when both figures are compared and any difference is investigated.
verify: Check the comparison result for differences.
Pass when platform count and TIV equal the file control totals.

steps.title: Tag the loaded exposure set with as-of date, version and DQ score
sop: Apply the as-of date, extract version and DQ score tags to the loaded set.
Confirm the tags are visible on the exposure set record.
Done when all three tags are applied and visible.
verify: Open the exposure set record and read the tags.
Pass when as-of date, version and DQ score are all present.

steps.title: Retire the prior exposure set in the cat platform
sop: Mark the previous cycle exposure set as retired or archived.
Confirm it can no longer be selected for a new run.
Done when the prior set is no longer selectable.
verify: Attempt to select the prior set in the run configuration list.
Pass when the prior set does not appear as selectable.

steps.title: Record acknowledgement of receipt from the CAT Modeler
sop: Confirm receipt of the delivered exposure set and its tags.
Record the acknowledgement against the delivery.
Done when a dated acknowledgement is recorded.
verify: Check the hand-off record for the acknowledgement entry.
Pass when a dated acknowledgement is present.

steps.title: Log the delivery with timestamp and file hash in the hand-off log
sop: Compute the file hash for the delivered file.
Record delivery timestamp, hash and version in the hand-off log.
Done when the log entry is complete.
verify: Recompute the hash and compare to the logged value.
Pass when the logged hash matches the delivered file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The exposure data quality report distributed to the Underwriting and Cat Modeling distribution list.
generic.In-scope period: Current monthly reporting period on the agreed monthly distribution date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report carries per-team breakdown, top ten TIV gaps and the extract as-of date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dashboard refresh timestamp matches the as-of date of the extract being reported.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Distribution logged with date, recipients and report version in the reporting register.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed refreshes or missed distribution dates logged with the reason and recovery date.
generic.Test population: The published report and the full recipient distribution list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report published on the agreed date with the per-underwriting-team breakdown present.
generic.Exception handling path: A stale or failed dashboard refresh blocks distribution until the refresh is rerun.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each underwriting team can see its own gaps and the top ten unresolved TIV policies.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI workspace for the published report with the register in the document repository.

steps.title: Refresh the exposure DQ dataset in Power BI
sop: Trigger the dataset refresh against the current as-of extract.
Confirm the refresh completes without a partition failure.
Done when the refresh completes and the timestamp updates.
verify: Read the refresh timestamp on the dataset.
Pass when the timestamp matches the extract as-of date.

steps.title: Confirm the per-underwriting-team breakdown renders in the report
sop: Open each underwriting team page in the report.
Confirm each team sees only its own gaps.
Done when every team page renders with its own data.
verify: Spot-check two team pages against the source data.
Pass when each team page shows only that team gaps.

steps.title: Add the top ten TIV policies with unresolved gaps to the report
sop: Rank unresolved gap policies by TIV.
Publish the top ten with attribute, team and TIV.
Done when the top ten list appears in the report.
verify: Recompute the ranking from the gap data.
Pass when the published ranking matches the recomputed order.

steps.title: Review the report content before release
sop: Review scores, gap lists and commentary for accuracy.
Confirm the report version and as-of date are stated.
Done when the report is approved for distribution.
verify: Check the approval note on the report version.
Pass when a dated approval is recorded.

steps.title: Publish the report to the Underwriting and Cat Modeling distribution list
sop: Publish to the agreed distribution list on the monthly date.
Confirm both Underwriting and Cat Modeling recipients are included.
Done when the report is published to the full list.
verify: Compare the recipient list to the agreed distribution list.
Pass when no agreed recipient is missing.

steps.title: Log the distribution in the exposure reporting register
sop: Record date, recipients and report version in the register.
File the released report copy in the document repository.
Done when the register entry and the filed copy both exist.
verify: Open the register entry and the filed copy.
Pass when the entry and the archived report version agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force and bound policies for the modelled lines held in the policy administration system.
generic.In-scope period: The agreed extract as-of date and time for the current modelling cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Location, coverage TIV, construction, occupancy, year built, deductible and limit all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extracted policy count and TIV reconcile to the policy system in-force report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract job id, run timestamp and record count recorded in the extract log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing mandatory fields and reconciliation differences logged with a disposition before release.
generic.Test population: All rows in the completed extract for the modelled lines of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Policy count and TIV must tie to the in-force report within the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: An out-of-tolerance reconciliation stops release and returns the extract for rerun.

steps.title: Confirm the extract as-of date and scope in the policy administration system

Confirm the modelled lines in scope for extraction.

verify: Compare the configured scope to the agreed cycle parameters.

steps.title: Run the policy-level exposure extract job in the policy administration system

Monitor the job to completion and capture the job id.

verify: Read the job status and output record count.
Pass when the job completed successfully with a non-zero row count.

steps.title: Filter the extract to in-force and bound policies only

steps.title: Check required exposure fields are populated in the extract

steps.title: Reconcile extracted policy count and TIV to the in-force report

Compare policy count and TIV to the extract and itemise differences.

steps.title: Land the extract in the data warehouse and log the job details

Record job id, run timestamp and record count in the extract log.

generic.Defined scope/population: All exposure locations carrying a null, defaulted or imputed key attribute value.
generic.In-scope period: Current exposure as-of date using the imputation rule set active for this cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each flagged row carries the attribute name, the flag type and the imputation rule applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged row counts split between genuinely missing and vendor-defaulted sum to the total flagged.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Flag output stored with rule-set version and run timestamp in the data warehouse.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Flagged high-TIV policies routed for review with a recorded review outcome.
generic.Test population: Every location with a missing, defaulted or imputed key attribute.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every imputed attribute carries a flag naming the imputation rule, with zero unflagged imputations.
generic.Exception handling path: High-TIV flagged policies escalate to Underwriting for source attribute capture.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Imputed values are held in a flag column and the source field is not overwritten.

steps.title: Define the key attribute flag rules in the data warehouse

Define null, default and imputed conditions per attribute.
Done when flag rules exist for every key attribute.
verify: Review the rule set for attributes without a rule.
Pass when every key attribute has a defined flag rule.

steps.title: Run the flagging job across the exposure set in the warehouse
sop: Execute the flagging job over all exposure locations.
Capture the imputation rule identifier on each flagged row.

verify: Query flagged rows with a null rule identifier.
Pass when no flagged row is missing its rule identifier.

steps.title: Split genuinely missing values from vendor-defaulted values

Report the two counts separately rather than combined.

verify: Add the two counts and compare to the total flagged.
Pass when the two counts sum to the total.

steps.title: Confirm imputed values are held in a dedicated flag column
sop: Inspect the exposure table structure for the flag columns.
Confirm source attribute values were not overwritten by imputation.
Done when source fields are confirmed intact.
verify: Compare sampled source field values before and after the job.
Pass when no source field value was overwritten.

steps.title: Rank flagged policies by TIV in Excel for review
sop: Export flagged policies with their TIV.
Rank descending by TIV and mark the review cut-off.
Done when the ranked review list is produced.
verify: Recompute the ranking from the exported data.
Pass when the list order matches the recomputed ranking.

steps.title: Add the flagged population to the known data limitations note
sop: Summarise flagged counts and TIV by attribute.
Add the summary to the limitations note travelling with the model run.
Done when the note carries the flagged population summary.
verify: Open the limitations note and read the flagged summary.
Pass when the note figures match the flag output.

generic.Defined scope/population: All extracted insured property locations submitted to the batch geocoder for this cycle.

steps.title: Confirm the geocoding dataset version with the Catastrophe Data Provider

steps.title: Report the match-level distribution by peril zone

steps.title: Publish the finished report to the Power BI reporting workspace

verify: Recompute the residual percentage.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off before releasing the exposure set

Done when the reconciliation is signed off.

Pass when preparer and reviewer names and dates are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The remediated exposure population plus the full validation rule set across the exposure extract.

steps.title: Confirm the remediation load completed in the data warehouse

Capture the remediated record count.

verify: Compare the loaded count to the remediation plan population.

steps.title: Snapshot the pre-remediation validation results for comparison

Store them alongside the rerun for before-and-after comparison.

Pass when the baseline covers the same rules and population.

steps.title: Rerun the full validation rule set in the warehouse
sop: Execute the complete rule set over the exposure extract.
Capture new pass and fail counts per rule.
Done when the rerun completes with counts captured per rule.
verify: Compare evaluated record counts between the runs.
Pass when the rerun evaluated the same record population.

steps.title: Confirm previously failing records now pass or carry an exception
sop: Join prior failures to the rerun results.
Confirm each is now passing or carries an accepted exception.
Done when every prior failure has a pass or an accepted exception.
verify: List prior failures still failing without an exception.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Test for regressions introduced by the remediation
sop: Identify records that passed before and fail now.
Investigate and record the cause of each regression.
Done when the regression list is produced with causes.
verify: Count records that moved from pass to fail.
Pass when the regression count is zero.

steps.title: Record before and after DQ scores for the remediated population
sop: Compute the DQ score for the remediated population in both runs.
Record both figures in the remediation evidence summary.
Done when both scores are recorded for the same population.
verify: Recompute the after score from the rerun output.
Pass when the recomputed score matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Close remediation items in the issue log on the evidenced fix
sop: Attach the rerun evidence to each remediation item.
Close only the items the rerun evidences as fixed.

verify: Review closed items for attached rerun evidence.
Pass when every closed item carries rerun evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: All locations sitting in the geocode failure queue after the batch geocoding run.

sop: Pull the failure queue with TIV per location.

steps.title: Apply address standardisation to queued addresses

sop: Assign a documented fallback resolution to each unresolved location.
Flag the location in the model run as fallback-resolved.

verify: Re-read corrected policy records in the policy system.

Quantify the TIV exposed to each failing attribute.

Confirm the note travels with the model run.
Done when the note carries the failing attribute list.

Pass when the failing attributes and TIV appear in the note.

steps.title: State the correlation assumption for each peril pair in Excel

Pass when no peril pair is left without a value.

steps.title: Distinguish causal dependency from statistical correlation

Mark the remainder as statistical correlation.
Done when every pair is classified.
verify: Review classifications for unmarked pairs.
Pass when every pair carries a classification.

steps.title: Test the matrix for positive semi-definiteness
sop: Run the positive semi-definite test on the matrix.
Adjust values and retest if the test fails.
Done when the matrix passes the test.
verify: Read the eigenvalue test output.
Pass when no negative eigenvalue is returned.

steps.title: Run the aggregation with the assumed matrix in the actuarial platform

Capture the aggregate result and the diversification benefit.
Done when the aggregate run completes with results captured.
verify: Compare aggregate result to the sum of standalone perils.
Pass when the diversification benefit is quantified.

steps.title: Bound the answer at zero and full correlation

Report the aggregate result at both bounds.
Done when both bounding runs are complete.
verify: Check the assumed result sits between the two bounds.
Pass when the assumed result lies within the bounds.

steps.title: Document the correlation basis and sensitivity for the cycle

Save the documentation with the matrix version.
Done when the documentation is saved against the matrix version.
verify: Open the documentation and check it covers basis and sensitivity.
Pass when both are documented for the version in use.

steps.title: Create the reporting cycle folder in the document repository

Apply the standard archive structure.

steps.title: Archive the final PML report with its supporting run id

Record the supporting model run id against it.
Done when report and run id are archived together.
verify: Follow the run id to the governance run register.

steps.title: Archive the submitted regulatory filing marked as filed

Mark it as filed so it is distinguishable from drafts.

steps.title: Archive rating agency questionnaires and correspondence

Store them in the same cycle folder.
Done when all agency items are archived.
verify: Compare archived agency items to the submission inventory.
Pass when every submitted item is archived.

steps.title: Record submission date, recipient and filer for each item
sop: Record submission date, regulator or agency and filer name.
Attach the metadata to each archived item.
Done when every item carries its submission metadata.
verify: Review archived items for missing metadata.
Pass when every item has all three values.

steps.title: Set retention and legal hold status on the archived items
sop: Apply the retention period to the cycle folder.
Set legal hold where applicable.
Done when retention and hold status are set.
verify: Read the retention and hold fields on the folder.
Pass when both are set as required.

generic.Defined scope/population: Final gross and net PML at the required return periods following treaty bind.
generic.In-scope period: Post-bind position for the current treaty period.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Final figures saved with run id, bound slip version and reviewer sign-off.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cover not yet placed excluded from credit and recorded as an exception.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Gross and net PML produced on bound terms and reconciled to the pre-bind estimate.
generic.Exception handling path: A reconciliation break to the pre-bind estimate is investigated before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reinsurance credit reflects only bound and signed cover.
generic.Evidence location: Cat modeling platform post-bind run with the final PML exhibit in Excel.

steps.title: Load the bound treaty terms into the cat modeling platform
sop: Enter the bound slip terms rather than the assumed placement structure.
Confirm the terms match the reinsurance system record.
Done when the bound terms are loaded.
verify: Compare loaded terms to the bound slip.
Pass when every term matches.

steps.title: Rerun net PML on the bound terms
sop: Rerun net PML using the bound structure.
Confirm the run completes and produces the required outputs.
Done when the post-bind net PML run is complete.
verify: Check the run status and output completeness.
Pass when the run completed with all outputs.

steps.title: Produce PML at every required return period
sop: Produce gross and net PML at the regulator, agency and capital return periods.
Confirm no required period is missing.
Done when all required periods are produced.
verify: Compare produced periods to the requirement list.
Pass when every required period is present.

steps.title: Confirm credit reflects only bound and signed cover
sop: Check the cover included in the credit against the bound record.
Exclude anything still to be placed.
Done when the credit basis reflects bound cover only.
verify: Compare included cover to the signed placement record.
Pass when only bound and signed cover is credited.

steps.title: Reconcile the final net PML to the pre-bind estimate
sop: Compare final net PML to the pre-bind estimate.
Explain the difference by structure change.
Done when the difference is explained.
verify: Check the explanation covers the full difference.
Pass when no unexplained residual remains.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off before release for reporting
sop: Review the final figures and the reconciliation.
Record the sign-off with name and date.
Done when the figures are signed off.
verify: Open the sign-off record.
Pass when a dated sign-off is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: AM Best, S&P and Moody's catastrophe exposure questionnaires for the current cycle.

steps.title: Collect the final approved PML figures for the cycle

Pass when they match the approved report.

steps.title: Map each agency return period and peril definition
sop: Read each agency return period and peril definition.
Map company perils and periods to the agency definitions.
Done when the mapping is complete for each agency.
verify: Review the mapping against each agency specification.
Pass when every requested definition is mapped.

steps.title: Populate gross and net fields and state the reinsurance basis
sop: Enter gross and net figures into the correct agency fields.
State the reinsurance basis behind the net figures.
Done when gross, net and basis are entered for each agency.
verify: Check field placement against the agency template.
Pass when gross and net sit in the correct fields.

steps.title: Reconcile the figures submitted across the three agencies
sop: Compare the figures going to each agency.
Explain any presentational difference in basis.
Done when the cross-agency reconciliation is complete.
verify: Test each agency figure against the same PML source.
Pass when all agencies tie to one approved source.

steps.title: Obtain internal review before submission
sop: Circulate each completed questionnaire for internal review.
Disposition all review comments.
Done when every questionnaire is reviewed and cleared.
verify: Check the review record per agency.
Pass when each questionnaire carries a dated review.

steps.title: Record submission date and agency contact per questionnaire

File the submitted version in the document repository.
Done when submission details are recorded and filed.
verify: Open each filed record and read the submission details.
Pass when date and contact are recorded for each agency.

steps.title: Reconcile the disclosed reserve to the ledger balance

steps.title: Reconcile the disclosed reserve to the actuarial reserve analysis
sop: Compare the disclosed figure to the actuarial reserve analysis.

verify: Review the explanation for each difference.
Pass when every difference is explained.

steps.title: Confirm gross, ceded and net presentation matches the statutory basis
sop: Check the presentation of gross, ceded and net in the footnote.
Confirm it follows the statutory presentation basis.
Done when the presentation basis is confirmed.
verify: Compare the presentation to the statutory requirement.
Pass when the presentation matches the requirement.

steps.title: Align the modelling basis narrative with the actuarial report
sop: Compare the footnote narrative to the actuarial report wording.
Correct any inconsistency in basis or uncertainty description.
Done when the narrative is aligned.
verify: Read both narratives side by side.
Pass when the two are consistent.

steps.title: Record the agreed wording and figures with both sign-offs
sop: File the agreed wording and figures before close.
Record Finance and Actuarial sign-offs.
Done when both sign-offs are recorded before close.
verify: Open the record and read both sign-offs.
Pass when both are present and dated before close.

generic.Defined scope/population: The catastrophe risk narrative section of the ORSA report and annual filing.

steps.title: Draft the perils, models and PML section

State the net retention position.
Done when the section is drafted.
verify: Trace the quoted PML to the PML report.
Pass when the quoted figures tie exactly.

steps.title: Describe the concentration limit framework and utilisation
sop: Describe the limit framework and current utilisation.
Disclose breaches occurring in the period.
Done when the limits section is drafted with breaches disclosed.
verify: Compare disclosed breaches to the breach report.
Pass when every period breach is disclosed.

steps.title: Describe the reinsurance programme and retained position
sop: Describe how the programme converts gross exposure to the retained position.
Reference the bound programme structure.
Done when the reinsurance section is drafted.
verify: Compare the description to the bound programme.

steps.title: State model limitations, data quality and uncertainty
sop: Insert the model limitations and data quality position.
State the resulting uncertainty around the figures.
Done when limitations and uncertainty are stated.
verify: Compare the statements to the limitations note.
Pass when the narrative reflects the filed limitations.

steps.title: Tie every quoted figure to the capital model and PML report
sop: List every figure quoted in the narrative.
Trace each to its capital model or PML report source.
Done when every figure has a traced source.
verify: Test the traces for each quoted figure.
Pass when every figure ties to its source.

steps.title: File the draft in the document management repository
sop: File the drafted narrative with version and date.
Reference the source documents used.
Done when the draft is filed with its references.
verify: Open the filed draft and check version and references.
Pass when both are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Event learnings assessed for incorporation into cat model calibration and assumptions.

steps.title: Compare modelled to actual loss for the event
sop: Take the modelled and actual loss for the event.
Identify which assumptions drove the variance.
Done when variance drivers are identified.
verify: Compare the figures to the post-event actuarial report.
Pass when the figures tie to that report.

steps.title: Classify each learning as an assumption change or noise
sop: Decide which findings change vulnerability, financial or exposure assumptions.
Mark the remainder as event-specific noise with the reason.
Done when every finding is classified.
verify: Review findings for missing classifications.
Pass when every finding carries a classification.

steps.title: Quantify the portfolio impact of each proposed change
sop: Run the proposed change against the portfolio in the cat platform.
Quantify the impact on AAL and PML.
Done when each proposed change has a quantified impact.
verify: Check each proposed change for a quantified impact.
Pass when none is unquantified.

steps.title: Raise a model change request for each accepted change
sop: Raise the change request in the model governance repository.
Attach the quantified impact to the request.
Done when a request exists for every accepted change.
verify: Compare requests to the accepted change list.
Pass when every accepted change has a request.

steps.title: Confirm approval and versioning before use in a published run
sop: Confirm each change is approved and assigned a version.
Confirm no unapproved change is in a published run.
Done when approvals and versions are confirmed.
verify: Check published runs for unapproved changes.
Pass when no published run carries an unapproved change.

steps.title: Record the learning and outcome in the model validation file
sop: Write the learning, the decision and the outcome into the validation file.
File it against the event and the model version.
Done when the validation file entry is complete.
verify: Open the validation file entry.
Pass when learning, decision and outcome are all recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The PML regulatory filing submitted for actuarial sign-off.

verify: Test two filing figures against the run output.

steps.title: Confirm peer review is complete and points are closed

steps.title: Confirm the data quality statement and limitations are disclosed
sop: Check the filing for the data quality statement and model limitations.
Confirm they reflect the current exposure and model position.
Done when both disclosures are confirmed present and current.
verify: Compare the disclosures to the limitations note.
Pass when the filing disclosures match the note.

steps.title: Identify the exact filing version being signed
sop: Record the filing version number and date presented for signature.
Confirm it is the version reviewed.
Done when the version to be signed is identified.
verify: Compare the version signed to the version reviewed.

steps.title: Record the sign-off with name, credential and date

File the sign-off record in the document repository.

verify: Open the sign-off record and read the fields.

Route any subsequent figure change for a re-signature.

verify: Compare the submitted version to the signed version.
Pass when no post-sign-off change exists without a re-signature.

verify: Compare the template structure to the regulator issue.

steps.title: Map internal zone and peril groupings to the regulator definitions
sop: Map internal zones and perils to the regulator groupings.

Correct any cross-footing failure.

verify: Run the cross-footing check on each exhibit.

steps.title: Tie exhibit totals to the PML report and capital model input
sop: Compare exhibit totals to the PML report and capital model input.
Explain any permitted basis difference.
Done when the ties are complete and documented.
verify: Test the ties for each exhibit total.
Pass when every total ties or the difference is explained.

sop: Compare prior-period columns to the previously filed submission.
Correct any inconsistency or disclose a restatement.

verify: Compare comparatives to the filed prior submission.
