Done when the event log entry is complete.
verify: Open the log entry and the filed bulletin.
Pass when the entry and the bulletin agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Treaty layers potentially affected by the loss event and requiring reinsurer notification.
generic.In-scope period: From event declaration to the notification deadline set by each treaty wording.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice carries event code, date, peril and the current estimate range per layer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Layers notified equal the layers assessed as potentially affected.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgement from each reinsurer or broker recorded against the notification.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers assessed as not potentially affected recorded with the assessment reason.
generic.Test population: Every layer of the bound programme assessed against the event estimate.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Notice issued per affected layer within the treaty deadline with acknowledgement recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: An unacknowledged notice is chased and escalated before the deadline expires.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification given for layers that may be reached, not only those already breached.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system notification records with notices filed in the repository.

steps.title: Read the loss notification clause for each affected layer
sop: Read the notification clause and deadline for each layer.
Record the deadline against each layer.
Done when every layer has a recorded notification deadline.
verify: Compare recorded deadlines to the treaty wording.
Pass when every deadline matches the wording.

steps.title: Assess which layers may be reached by the event estimate
sop: Compare the current estimate range to each layer attachment.
Mark layers that may be reached, not only those breached.
Done when every layer carries an assessment.
verify: Review the assessment against the estimate range.
Pass when layers within the range are marked affected.

steps.title: Draft the notice with event code, date, peril and estimate range
sop: Draft the notice content per the treaty requirement.
Include event code, date, peril and current estimate range.
Done when the notice draft is complete.
verify: Check the draft against the clause requirements.
Pass when every required element is present.

steps.title: Issue the notice to the broker and reinsurers
sop: Issue the notice through the reinsurance administration system.
Confirm it reached the broker and each participating reinsurer.
Done when the notice is issued to all parties.
verify: Compare the issue date to the treaty deadline.
Pass when every notice was issued within its deadline.

steps.title: Record acknowledgement from each reinsurer or broker
sop: Chase and record acknowledgement from each party.
Escalate where acknowledgement is not received.
Done when acknowledgements are recorded or escalated.
verify: Review the notification record for missing acknowledgements.
Pass when each notice has an acknowledgement or escalation.

steps.title: Diarise the follow-up updates required by the wording
sop: Read the follow-up reporting obligations in the wording.
Diarise each required update date.
Done when every follow-up obligation is diarised.
verify: Compare diarised dates to the wording obligations.
Pass when every obligation has a diarised date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Regulatory notifications prepared for state DOI and NAIC for the qualifying catastrophe event.
generic.In-scope period: From event qualification to each jurisdiction notification deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event identifier, affected states, policy counts, exposure and estimated loss populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures used match the current loss bulletin for the same event code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Prepared notification filed with intended submission date and internal approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Jurisdictions assessed as not triggered recorded with the assessment.
generic.Test population: Every jurisdiction with a notification trigger tested against the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Prepared notification per triggered jurisdiction with figures tying to the bulletin.
generic.Exception handling path: An approaching deadline without internal approval is escalated immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claims handling and consumer contact information included where the jurisdiction requires.
generic.Evidence location: Prepared notifications in the document repository with figures assembled in Excel.

steps.title: Determine which state and NAIC triggers the event meets
sop: Test the event against each jurisdiction notification trigger.
Record the assessment and the due date where triggered.
Done when every jurisdiction has an assessment.
verify: Review the assessments for uncovered jurisdictions.
Pass when every jurisdiction has been assessed.

steps.title: Assemble policy counts, exposure and loss estimate in Excel
sop: Assemble affected policy counts, exposure and estimated loss by state.
Source the figures from the current loss bulletin.
Done when the figures are assembled by state.
verify: Compare the figures to the current bulletin.
Pass when they tie to the bulletin.

steps.title: Prepare the notification per triggered jurisdiction
sop: Prepare the notification in the required jurisdiction format.
Include the event identifier and affected states.
Done when a prepared notification exists per triggered jurisdiction.
verify: Compare prepared notifications to the triggered list.
Pass when every triggered jurisdiction has one.

steps.title: Include claims handling and consumer contact information
sop: Add the claims handling and consumer contact details required.
Confirm the details are current.
Done when the required contact information is included.
verify: Compare the details to the jurisdiction requirement.
Pass when every required detail is present.

steps.title: Set the intended submission date ahead of each deadline
sop: Set an internal submission date ahead of each statutory deadline.
Record the dates against each notification.
Done when every notification has an internal date.
verify: Compare internal dates to statutory deadlines.
Pass when each internal date precedes its deadline.

steps.title: Obtain internal approval on each prepared notification
sop: Route each notification for internal approval.
Record the approver and date.
Done when every notification is approved.
verify: Open each notification and read the approval.
Pass when all are approved and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Post-event actuarial analysis of model accuracy against the ultimate actual outcome.
generic.In-scope period: The event at the stated claims data cut-off for the ultimate comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Modelled loss, ultimate actual loss, variance drivers and recommendations all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ultimate actual loss ties to the claims warehouse total for the event code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report issued with claims cut-off, model run id and issue date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recommendations recorded with a named owner and a due date.
generic.Test population: The full event loss population and the initial estimate range issued.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Modelled versus ultimate actual loss with variance attribution and owned recommendations.
generic.Exception handling path: An unattributed variance is investigated before the report is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment of whether the initial estimate range contained the eventual outcome.
generic.Evidence location: Report in Excel with modelled output from the actuarial modeling platform.

steps.title: Establish the ultimate actual loss at the claims cut-off
sop: Take the ultimate actual loss for the event code.
State the claims data cut-off date.
Done when the ultimate position is established.
verify: Compare the ultimate figure to the claims warehouse.
Pass when the figures tie.

steps.title: Compare final modelled loss to the ultimate actual loss
sop: Extract the final modelled loss from the modeling platform.
Compare it to the ultimate actual loss.
Done when the comparison is complete.
verify: Check the run id behind the modelled figure.
Pass when the figure comes from the final event run.

steps.title: Attribute the variance across the driver categories
sop: Attribute variance to hazard, vulnerability, exposure data, policy terms and inflation.
Quantify each driver.
Done when the variance is fully attributed.
verify: Sum the driver contributions against the total variance.
Pass when they sum to the total.

steps.title: Assess whether the initial range contained the outcome
sop: Compare the ultimate outcome to the initial estimate range.
Comment on the width of the range issued.
Done when the range assessment is recorded.
verify: Test the outcome against the issued range bounds.
Pass when the assessment states containment and range width.

steps.title: Recommend model, data or process changes with owners
sop: List recommended changes arising from the analysis.
Assign a named owner and due date to each.
Done when every recommendation has an owner and date.
verify: Review recommendations for missing owners or dates.
Pass when none is missing either.

steps.title: Issue the report to the downstream teams and model governance owner
sop: Issue to Capital Modeling, Reserving, Underwriting and model governance.
Record the issue date and recipients.
Done when the report is issued and logged.
verify: Check the issue log against the intended recipients.
Pass when all four received the report.

generic.Defined scope/population: Preliminary gross and net loss estimate for the declared event across affected policies.
generic.In-scope period: The initial estimate window with an explicit data cut-off and refresh date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Low, central and high estimates populated gross and net with key assumptions stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gross estimate reconciles to the sum of policy-level modelled losses.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Estimate labelled preliminary with data cut-off, footprint version and run id.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: High-leverage assumptions recorded with their assumed values.
generic.Test population: All in-force-at-event policies inside the footprint.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Gross and net estimate presented as a range with cut-off and assumptions stated.
generic.Exception handling path: A single-point estimate without a range is not issued at the preliminary stage.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reinsurance structure applied to produce the net estimate alongside the gross.
generic.Evidence location: Preliminary estimate run in the cat modeling platform with the exhibit in Excel.

steps.title: Run the footprint against the in-force-at-event exposure
sop: Run the event footprint against the loss-date exposure extract.
Confirm the run covers all footprint locations.
Done when the run completes across the affected population.
verify: Compare the modelled population to the extract count.
Pass when the run covers the full extract.

steps.title: Apply policy terms to derive gross loss
sop: Apply limits, deductibles and coverage parts to the modelled damage.
Derive the gross loss estimate.
Done when the gross loss is derived.
verify: Sample policies and recompute the applied terms.
Pass when sampled losses match the applied terms.

steps.title: Produce a low, central and high estimate range
sop: Flex the key assumptions to produce low and high bounds.
Present the range rather than a single point.
Done when the three-point range is produced.
verify: Check the central estimate lies within the bounds.
Pass when the range is internally consistent.

steps.title: Apply the reinsurance structure to produce the net estimate
sop: Apply the bound reinsurance structure to the gross range.
Produce the net estimate alongside the gross.
Done when the net estimate exists for the range.
verify: Compare the structure applied to the bound programme.
Pass when the bound structure was used.

steps.title: State the assumptions with greatest leverage on the estimate
sop: Identify the assumptions with the largest effect on the estimate.
State each with its assumed value.
Done when the leveraged assumptions are stated.
verify: Review the assumption list against the sensitivity of the estimate.
Pass when the highest-leverage assumptions are named.

steps.title: Label the estimate preliminary with cut-off and refresh date
sop: Label the estimate as preliminary.
State the data cut-off and the expected refresh date.
Done when the labelling is complete.
verify: Read the estimate labelling.
Pass when preliminary status, cut-off and refresh date are shown.

generic.Defined scope/population: Catastrophe claims emergence for the event reconciled to the modelled loss expectation.
generic.In-scope period: Each claims cut-off from the event date through the monitoring window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reported count, paid, case reserves and modelled expectation populated per cut-off.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims used tie to the warehouse totals for the correct event code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation saved with claims cut-off date and modelled expectation version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims assigned to the wrong event code corrected and the correction recorded.
generic.Test population: All catastrophe claims for the event across region and coverage.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No catastrophe claim left unassigned or assigned to the wrong event code.
generic.Exception handling path: Emergence indicating the estimate must move triggers a flag to the estimate owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Actual versus expected compared by region and coverage, not only in total.
generic.Evidence location: Claims data in the data warehouse with the reconciliation workbook in Excel.

steps.title: Extract event claims from the data warehouse by event code
sop: Extract reported count, paid and case reserves by event code.
State the claims cut-off date on the extract.
Done when the claims extract is produced.
verify: Compare the extract totals to the warehouse event totals.
Pass when they tie.

steps.title: Check event code assignment on catastrophe claims
sop: Identify catastrophe claims unassigned or on the wrong event code.
Route corrections to the claims owner.
Done when every catastrophe claim is correctly coded.
verify: Query catastrophe claims by event code assignment.
Pass when none is unassigned or wrongly assigned.

steps.title: Build the expected emergence pattern from the model
sop: Derive the expected reported and paid pattern from the modelled loss.
Align the pattern to the claims cut-off points.
Done when the expected pattern is aligned to the cut-offs.
verify: Check the pattern ties to the modelled loss total.
Pass when the pattern reconciles to the model.

steps.title: Compare actual to expected by region and coverage in Excel
sop: Compare actual emergence to expectation by region and coverage.
Quantify the variance at each level.
Done when the comparison is complete at both levels.
verify: Check the comparison covers every region and coverage.
Pass when none is omitted.

steps.title: Identify whether variance is frequency, severity or reporting speed
sop: Decompose the variance across the three effects.
Record the dominant driver.
Done when the variance decomposition is complete.
verify: Review the decomposition for a stated dominant driver.
Pass when a driver is identified.

steps.title: Flag where emergence indicates the estimate must move
sop: Assess whether emergence is outside the estimate range.
Raise a flag to the estimate owner where it is.
Done when the assessment is recorded and flags raised.
verify: Compare emergence to the current estimate range.
Pass when every breach of the range carries a flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: Refreshed loss estimates for the event at the 30, 60 and 90-day cut-offs.
generic.In-scope period: The 30, 60 and 90-day intervals following the event date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each refresh carries estimate range, model versus claims weighting and movement drivers.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each refresh reconciles to the previous estimate with the movement explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each refresh issued on its scheduled date with superseded figures marked.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: A range that does not narrow recorded with the reason.
generic.Test population: All three scheduled refreshes for the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each scheduled refresh completed on time with weighting stated and movement explained.
generic.Exception handling path: A missed refresh date is escalated and completed with the delay recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Weight shifts from model view to claims-based development as data matures.
generic.Evidence location: Refresh workbooks in Excel with claims data drawn from the data warehouse.

steps.title: Pull the latest claims emergence at each cut-off
sop: Extract claims emergence at the 30, 60 or 90-day cut-off.
Confirm the correct event code and cut-off date.
Done when the emergence data is extracted for the cut-off.
verify: Compare the extract to the warehouse event totals.
Pass when they tie.

steps.title: Refresh the modelled view against current information
sop: Rerun or restate the modelled view with current footprint and exposure.
Record the version used for the refresh.
Done when the modelled view is refreshed.
verify: Check the footprint and exposure versions on the refresh.
Pass when both are recorded.

steps.title: State the weighting between model and claims development views
sop: Set the weight given to the model view and the claims development view.
State the weighting explicitly in the refresh.
Done when the weighting is stated.
verify: Check the weights sum correctly and are stated.
Pass when the weighting is explicit and consistent.

steps.title: Narrow the estimate range or explain why it has not
sop: Compare the new range to the prior range.
Narrow it or record why uncertainty has not reduced.
Done when the range is set with an explanation where unchanged.
verify: Compare range widths across refreshes.
Pass when narrowing occurred or is explained.

steps.title: Reconcile the refresh to the previous estimate
sop: Compare the refreshed estimate to the previous one.
Explain the movement by driver.
Done when the movement is explained.
verify: Check the movement explanation covers the full change.
Pass when no unexplained residual remains.

steps.title: Issue the refresh on schedule and mark superseded figures
sop: Issue the refresh on the scheduled date.
Mark the superseded figures clearly.
Done when the refresh is issued and superseded figures marked.
verify: Compare the issue date to the schedule.
Pass when each refresh was issued on its scheduled date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The post-event cat model run using industry loss reports and event parameters.
generic.In-scope period: The event, run against in-force-at-event exposure and the current footprint version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Industry loss source, event parameters, footprint version and exposure as-of date recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled company loss over industry loss gives an implied share for comparison.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Run versioned with the industry loss source and vintage recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material divergence between implied and expected share investigated and explained.
generic.Test population: The full in-force-at-event exposure inside the footprint.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Run recorded with industry source, parameters, footprint version and exposure as-of date.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained share divergence returns the run for investigation before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Implied share compared to the expected share for the affected territory.
generic.Evidence location: Post-event run in the cat modeling platform with industry data from the data provider.

steps.title: Load the industry loss estimate from the Catastrophe Data Provider
sop: Load the PCS or PERILS industry estimate for the event.
Record the source and its vintage.
Done when the industry estimate is loaded and recorded.
verify: Check the recorded source and vintage.
Pass when both are present on the run.

steps.title: Enter the event parameters into the post-event run
sop: Enter the event parameters supplied for the event.
Confirm they match the provider event record.
Done when the parameters are entered and confirmed.
verify: Compare entered parameters to the provider record.
Pass when they match.

steps.title: Run the event against in-force-at-event exposure
sop: Run the event with the current footprint version against the loss-date exposure.
Confirm the run completes across the affected population.
Done when the run completes.
verify: Check the exposure as-of date on the run.
Pass when the run used the loss-date exposure.

steps.title: Derive the implied company market share
sop: Divide modelled company loss by the industry loss estimate.
Record the implied market share.
Done when the implied share is derived.
verify: Recompute the implied share from the two inputs.
Pass when the recomputed share matches.

steps.title: Compare implied share to the expected territory share
sop: Compare the implied share to the expected share for the territory.
Record the difference.
Done when the comparison is recorded.
verify: Check the expected share source used.
Pass when the expected share comes from the portfolio position.

steps.title: Investigate and explain material share divergence
sop: Investigate divergence beyond the agreed tolerance.
Record the explanation or the corrective action.
Done when material divergence is explained.
verify: Review divergence entries for explanations.
Pass when every material divergence is explained.

steps.title: Version the run and record the industry source and vintage
sop: Save the run under a version with the industry source and vintage.
Link the version to the estimate it supports.
Done when the run is versioned and linked.
verify: Reopen the run record and read source and vintage.
Pass when both are recorded on the versioned run.
